svg.text: Each purchase brings a new external payment. PCS can then be donated onward.
Donor A pays Receiver A directly.
After confirmation: Receiver A transfers PCS to Donor A.
Donor A transfers PCS to Receiver B.
Receiver B now has PCS available to sell.
Donor B pays Receiver B directly.
After confirmation: Receiver B transfers PCS to Donor B.
Donor B transfers PCS to the next receiver.
The pattern repeats with new donors and receivers.
Fresh payments provide assistance. Internal PCS transfers do not create cash.
